flags.text: Profit lagging sales over 3y (-2.7% vs 11.0%): margins under pressure
Operating margin down 700 bps over 3 years
Cash conversion strong: 5y operating cash = 106% of profit
Cash cycle tightened by 24 days in 2 years (271 → 247)

guidance.promise: Expect margins to improve and be above 50% in FY27
guidance.quote: Given our focus on cost efficiencies and productivity improvement, we expect the margins to improve and be above 50% in FY27.
guidance.speaker: M. V. Narasimham

guidance.promise: Expect effective tax rate to be 24 to 25% for fiscal FY27
guidance.quote: We expect the ETR to be 24 to 25% for fiscal FY27.
guidance.speaker: M. V. Narasimham

guidance.promise: Expect semaglutide volume sales between 6 to 7 million units until end of calendar 26
guidance.quote: Specifically, for the next, let's say, until the end of calendar ‘26, I believe that the number is somewhere between 6 to 7 million units.
guidance.speaker: Erez Israeli

guidance.promise: Expect R&D spend to be in the range of 7-8% in fiscal ahead

guidance.speaker: M. V. Narasimham

guidance.promise: Expect capex for next year to be around 2,000 crores

claims.claim: Delivered highest ever annual revenues amid headwinds and one-time impacts
claims.quote: FY26 reflected a resilient operating performance, delivering highest ever annual revenues, amid product-specific headwinds and certain one-time impacts.

credibility.line: Met Q2 EBITDA margin target of 20%, but repeatedly trimmed capex guidance and hit semaglutide supply pauses.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management claimed base business double-digit growth, but total revenue fell 5.5% in Jun 2026 and 1.5% in Sep 2026.
Management highlighted 20.6% Q2 EBITDA margin, whereas reported GAAP EBITDA margin was 20.0% and EBIT margin was 13.8%.
Operating cash flow conversion remains healthy with 5-year OCF at 106% of cumulative net profit.

bull: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin recovered to 20.0% from 11.0% in Q1 FY27.
Strong cash generation with 5-year operating cash flow equal to 106% of net profit.
Aurigene CDMO business generated over $100 million revenue in the past 12 months.
bear: Borrowings increased 3.6x over 3 years from ₹2,002 crore in Mar 2024 to ₹7,229 crore in Sep 2026.
Operating EBIT margin contracted 700 bps over 3 years as profit growth lagged sales.
PAT declined YoY for three consecutive quarters, dropping 69.1% in Jun 2026 and 31.7% in Sep 2026.
watch: Validation and delivery of 6-7 million semaglutide pens by March FY27.
R&D spend holding within the guided 7-8% range.
FY27 capex cash outflow relative to revised ₹1,600-1,700 crore guidance.
